notes: BUU v3.0.4 - scheduled runs join the main code path. Scheduled runs now run EXACTLY like a manual run - same launch code - so scheduled workers actually log in and the flow's saved settings (error handling, retries, pool settings) are honored instead of hardcoded; the schedule picker lists only flows with the Automation box checked. Back-to-back runs without closing BUU are fixed: completed jobs clear automatically at launch (they used to silently re-run), the launch re-checks every staged spreadsheet still exists (archived sheets used to crash-loop workers), and if workers die instantly the pool STOPS after 3 and shows the error instead of respawning forever. Dead sessions are detected on the first failed attempt (was ~90s of doomed retries). A click whose After-check timed out no longer retries the row - that retry was writing duplicate notes. Max workers defaults to 20 (150 ceiling unchanged). Dragging a step near the list edge now auto-scrolls.
